translated_title: Is Terry Cole "Promoting" Harfuch? The US Has Always Sought to Divide Us, Sheinbaum Says
original_title: ¿Terry Cole “promueve” a Harfuch? EU siempre ha buscado dividirnos, dice Sheinbaum
author: Sugeyry Romina Gándara
meta_description: "They run into a wall, because Mexico's security Cabinet has enormous coordination and unity," Sheinbaum said, dismissing US attempts to divide her government.
